name: ops_controls_dead_letter_count_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: OPS_CONTROLS_N8N_OUTCOMES_DEAD_LETTER_COUNT_20261107 — LQ-20261107-148. The Ops Controls n8n tab
reported 'N open dead letter(s)' from len() of the query that finds the newest dead letter, LIMIT 20.
The lane n8n-research-intake-consumer held 113 unreleased dead letters on 2026-11-07 (the tail of the
2026-10-23 safe_flock cron outage) and the site said 20. The count is now a count(*) on the same indexed
predicate; the newest-row example keeps its own bounded query. Listing this schedules nothing.
